cards.en: the date or time by which a task must be finished
cards.example: The deadline for the report is Friday.
cards.translation: La fecha límite del informe es el viernes.
cards.prompt: The ___ for the report is Friday.

cards.en: the amount of work a person has to do
cards.example: My workload is heavier this week.
cards.translation: Esta semana tengo más carga de trabajo.

cards.en: to discuss with someone to reach an agreement
cards.example: We need to negotiate a new delivery date.
cards.translation: Tenemos que negociar una nueva fecha de entrega.
cards.prompt: We need to ___ a new delivery date.

cards.en: information about how well something is working
cards.example: Can you give me feedback on the first draft?
cards.translation: ¿Me puedes dar tu opinión sobre el primer borrador?
cards.prompt: Can you give me ___ on the first draft?

cards.en: something that is more important than other things
cards.example: The client meeting is our priority today.
cards.translation: La reunión con el cliente es nuestra prioridad hoy.
cards.prompt: The client meeting is our ___ today.

cards.en: a further action to check what happened after an earlier one
cards.example: Let us arrange a follow-up call next week.
cards.translation: Organicemos una llamada de seguimiento la semana que viene.
cards.prompt: Let us arrange a ___ call next week.

cards.en: a plan for how much money you will earn and spend
cards.example: We need a monthly budget for food and rent.
cards.translation: Necesitamos un presupuesto mensual para comida y alquiler.
cards.prompt: We need a monthly ___ for food and rent.

cards.en: money that you owe to a person or a bank
cards.example: She is working extra hours to pay off her debt.
cards.translation: Ella hace horas extra para pagar su deuda.
cards.prompt: She is working extra hours to pay off her ___.

cards.en: money that you spend on something
cards.example: Travel is our biggest expense this year.
cards.translation: Los viajes son nuestro mayor gasto este año.
cards.prompt: Travel is our biggest ___ this year.

cards.en: money that you earn from work or from other sources
cards.example: His income is not enough to live in the city.
cards.translation: Sus ingresos no son suficientes para vivir en la ciudad.
cards.prompt: His ___ is not enough to live in the city.

cards.en: an amount of money that a bank lends you and that you must pay back
cards.example: They took a loan to buy a small flat.
cards.translation: Pidieron un préstamo para comprar un piso pequeño.
cards.prompt: They took a ___ to buy a small flat.

cards.en: an agreement to pay a company so that it pays for damage, loss or illness
cards.translation: Nuestro seguro de coche cubre los accidentes.
